name: status-board
description: Shows a status board the model writes for this session, optionally proofread against rules you name, a one-line status above the prompt, and the per-prompt history of plans, steps, recaps, questions and linked pull requests

proofreadRules.title: Proofreading rules
proofreadRules.description: Path to a Markdown file (a skill's SKILL.md, or rules of your own) the finished board is proofread against; a folder means its SKILL.md, a leading ~/ is your home, and a whole * segment takes the highest version found there. Empty: no proofreading.

proofreadModel.title: Proofreading model
proofreadModel.description: The model that proofreads the board: an alias such as haiku, sonnet or opus, or a full model id.
